peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is cross border data restrictions in China?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Simply put, cross-border data flow is restricted due to personal information protection reasons. However, data processors may still transfer data across borders as long as they (i) pass a security assessment, (ii) obtain personal data protection certification, (iii) enter into standard data protection contracts.
